_source: Game8 'How to Level Up Fast' + earlier community claims (2026-11-15). Rewrite in our words. XP figures per kill from Game8.
general: Kill groups: ~10 goblins ~ one Cyclops in XP
Rest at campfires to respawn enemies (random timers); cook food with a camping kit for stat boosts
Cyclops and Minotaur respawn ~3 in-game days; Drake ~7 days
AoE pawns (Sorcerer, Warrior) clear mobs faster; Thief pawn with Bump and Lift steals items
Ring of Ambition gives slight bonus XP
Warfarer splits earned XP and DCP across all unlocked vocations: keep only the target vocation unlocked to level it quickly

spots.where: Campfire near Checkpoint Rest Town (west Vernworth oxcart ~200G)
spots.what: many Rock Lizards (624 xp each); passage beyond has Armored Cyclops 2,678, two Minotaurs 3,296 each, hidden Chimera 5,047
spots.route: descend bridge, follow stream to cave, hug right and climb out, cross wooden bridge to campfire

spots.where: Reach Bakbattahl early via Guerco Cavern (easier: one Stone Golem + Chimera) or the northern canyon from Checkpoint (hard: Cyclops, 2 Minotaurs, Chimera)
spots.what: Knackers there give 200-500 xp and 100-150 DCP vs goblins near Vernworth 100-150 xp, 20-50 DCP

spots.where: Western road of Bakbattahl, campfire south of road
Volcanic Island (after Put a Spring in Thy Step: Magick Archer + Martyr's Bolt, or Sotted Sage: Warfarer)
spots.what: strong xp/DCP; Martyr's Bolt can drop Drakes in 1-2 hits at HP cost
Knacker 417, Redwolf 479, Lost Mercenary 556 xp; Gore Harpies need a ranged weapon; Medusan Spellbow adds bonus XP

spots.where: Drake fights, Lost Rites dungeons (DLC, repeatable)
spots.what: see Game8 for numbers; DLC xp rewards are large (side quests 25,000-200,000)
